structured.answer: I'd go with מיטב's "עוקב מדדי מניות" (kupa 7867): it showed one of the biggest returns on the page, 25.86% over 3 years and 17.25% over 5, the fee of 0.65% looks tiny, and מיטב is a name I know from ads.

stuck.why: Dozens of rows that look the same, nothing marked as recommended or 'start here'. I got bored and stopped around מנורה מבטחים without seeing the last screens.

stuck.where: Return column, 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים'
stuck.why: Many rows have this instead of a number. I wasn't sure what it means, so I ignored those rows.

stuck.where: Choosing between אנליסט 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' (26.39%) and מיטב 'עוקב מדדי מניות' (25.86% / 17.25%)
stuck.why: אנליסט had the biggest 3-year number, but I've never heard of them. I went with the name I know.

stuck.where: Filter buttons at the top ('עוקב מדד S&P 500 12' etc.)
stuck.why: Didn't know if I should filter first or just scroll. I didn't press anything.

used: Heading 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and the highlighted 'קופת גמל להשקעה 143' button
Track names in the right column (עוקב מדד S&P 500, מניות, עוקב מדדי מניות, עוקב מדדים - גמיש)
Company group headers (הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס, ילין לפידות, מגדל, כלל, מנורה מבטחים)
Big green return numbers: '3 שנים' / '5 שנים' percentages
Fee 'מהחיסכון' percent next to each row
skimmed: Company summary bars (number of tracks, כסף מנוהל, fee range)
skipped: Small grey text about the data source ('מנתוני רשות שוק ההון', '123 מקור', '123 מחושב')
'חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח' column with the coloured rings
Arrows at the end of rows
unsure_meaning: 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים' in place of a return
Whether '25.86%' next to '3 שנים' is per year or total over 3 years
'עוד לא דווח' with an orange ! icon
Teal and yellow rings and dots
Kupa numbers like 7867 with a little link icon
not_found: A recommended or 'best for beginners' option
What the first step is to actually open the fund
A fee shown in shekels instead of percent
What the different track names actually mean, in plain words

findings.what: Way too many near-identical rows (143 tracks) with nothing recommended. I gave up scrolling about three-quarters of the way down.
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים' instead of a return, so I couldn't compare them and just ignored them
Not clear at a glance whether the 3- and 5-year % is yearly or total. The header is small and scrolls away from the numbers.
Orange ! 'עוד לא דווח' looks like a warning and scared me off those rows
findings.where: Fee column, e.g. מגדל and some כלל, מור, מיטב, אלטשולר rows

findings.what: Two fees, 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות', and I didn't know which one matters or how much it costs in shekels
Coloured rings and 'מט"ח' percentages mean nothing to me, and some are over 100%
Unfamiliar company names (אנליסט) top the returns, so I had to choose between a big number and a name I know
No next step: nothing on the page tells me how to actually open the fund
